Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A job report describes mixed relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant offers traditional Swiss cuisine, including cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue, in a cozy alpine-inspired setting with rustic wooden interiors, city skyline views, and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora, I visited www.dora-website.com. The content clearly identifies it as your personal website and makes your email easy to find, which is helpful for visitors who want to contact you. It feels quite minimal; a short introduction about you, your interests or work, and a few examples of projects would help visitors get to know you. My feedback is based on the text available on the site.

Hi Eve, I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning hiking as your favorite hobby gives the blog a personal touch and a clear starting point. I'd love to see that expanded into trail stories, route recommendations, photos, or practical hiking tips. A short introduction would also help readers get to know you. My feedback is based on the text available on the site.
